scenarios.name: continuous_unambiguous_entity
scenarios.setup: One entity moves smoothly across adjacent legal observations.
expected: One observer-local track retains continuity with high association confidence.
prohibited: Server UUID/entity ID used as association evidence.

scenarios.name: new_same_type_entity
scenarios.setup: A second same-type entity appears far from an existing track.
expected: A new track is created when association evidence is insufficient.
prohibited: Forced reassignment solely because the type matches.

scenarios.name: short_occlusion
scenarios.setup: One entity disappears for a bounded gap then reappears near predicted motion.
expected: Track may resume with reduced confidence and explicit gap history.

scenarios.name: long_occlusion
scenarios.setup: Entity remains unavailable beyond configured track retention.
expected: Old track becomes lost; later sighting is new or explicitly uncertain.
prohibited: Perfect identity continuation from server identity.

scenarios.name: identical_crossing_ambiguity
scenarios.setup: Two similar same-type entities cross with insufficient distinguishing evidence.
expected: Association is left ambiguous or new tracklets are created; confidence reflects ambiguity.
prohibited: History rewritten to conceal identity switch.

scenarios.name: observed_death
prohibited: Termination inferred from hidden server removal.

scenarios.name: unseen_despawn
scenarios.setup: Entity leaves legal access and is later removed by the server while unseen.
expected: Tracker reaches occluded_hypothesis/lost only; evaluator may record true despawn separately.
prohibited: Policy-visible despawn event from hidden server state.

scenarios.name: observed_transformation
scenarios.setup: A visible entity transforms type during a legitimately observed transition.
expected: Same track may update type with observed_transformation evidence.
prohibited: Type continuity decided by hidden UUID.

scenarios.name: unobserved_type_replacement
scenarios.setup: An entity disappears and a different type later appears without transition evidence.
expected: Continuity is not guaranteed; create new/uncertain track.

scenarios.name: mount_passenger_relation
scenarios.setup: Rider and mount are currently visible with a player-facing relationship.
expected: Current sparse relation edge may reference observation/track refs and becomes stale when endpoints are lost.

scenarios.name: projectile
scenarios.setup: A visible projectile crosses the sensed region.
expected: Short-lived track based on type/motion; source only when legitimately observed.

scenarios.name: public_player_identity_evidence
scenarios.setup: A player-facing identity cue is legitimately observed across separate sightings.
expected: Public identity evidence may raise re-association confidence without exposing authenticated UUID.
prohibited: Minecraft authenticated UUID/session identity as cognition input.

scenarios.name: cross_agent_isolation
scenarios.setup: Two agents independently observe the same physical entity.
expected: Each maintains its own track namespace, evidence and confidence.
prohibited: Shared private track ref or evaluator identity injected into both agents.
